display.title: Episode 125: The Rambam's Resting Place, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Robbers attack the caravan carrying the Rambam to Eretz Yisroel, and a camel led by an unseen hand finds his resting place in Teveria. Also: the Twelve Pesukim and starting Chumash Bamidbar.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with an offer: write in and say when and where you recite the Twelve Pesukim, on the school bus, in the park or on the swing, and receive a free copy of the new tape Story Time with Uncle Yossi No. 9. Story time continues the account of the Rambam's burial. His students carry his coffin out of Egypt on a camel, and in the middle of the desert a band of robbers attacks. Everyone flees, but each robber who reaches for the box falls to the ground, and the rest run away in fright. Then the camel sets off on its own, as if led by someone, past the border of Eretz Yisroel, until it kneels in a field in Teveria, where the Rambam is buried to this day. In between, two brothers from Studio 604 lead the Shema and speak about the Twelve Pesukim. A girl's letter in the mailbox brings a lesson about doing homework first and an explanation of how to join Tzivos Hashem. The show ends with a talk on behaving quietly in shul, calling out 'Chazak' at the end of Vayikra, and beginning Chumash Bamidbar this Shabbos.
display.lesson: Hashem never sleeps and guards the Jewish people; the resting place of a tzaddik is holy, and his teachings are learned to this day.

date.note: 'Last week we finished Vayikra, this Shabbos we begin Bamidbar' points to 29 May 1984, but weekly spacing back from 127 (Erev Shavuos, 5 June 1984) gives 22 May.

advisories.note: Armed robbers attack a caravan in the desert.
The story is about the Rambam's burial; two robbers fall down lifeless when they reach for his coffin.
